subgoals.objective_name: To prevent unauthorized disclosure, modification, removal or destruction of information stored on media.
subgoals.goal_name: Prevent unauthorized disclosure, modification, removal or destruction of information stored on media

subgoals.control_name: Procedures shall be implemented for the management of removable media in accordance with the classification scheme adopted by the organization.

subgoals.goal_name: Implement procedures for the management of removable media in accordance with the classification scheme adopted by the organization
subgoals.embedding_context: Implement procedures for the management of removable media in accordance with the classification scheme adopted by the organization

actions.name: Disk Formatting
actions.description: Disk Formatting is the process of preparing a data storage device, such as a hard drive, solid-state drive, or USB flash drive, for initial use.

actions.name: IO Port Restriction
actions.description: Limiting access to computer input/output (IO) ports to restrict unauthorized devices.

subgoals.control_name: Media shall be disposed of securely when no longer required, using formal procedures.

subgoals.goal_name: Dispose of media securely when no longer required, using formal procedures
subgoals.embedding_context: Dispose of media securely when no longer required, using formal procedures

actions.name: File Eviction
actions.description: File eviction techniques delete files from system storage.

actions.name: Disk Erasure
actions.description: Disk Erasure is the process of securely deleting all data on a disk to ensure that it cannot be recovered by any means.

subgoals.control_name: Media containing information shall be protected against unauthorized access, misuse or corruption during transportation.

subgoals.goal_name: Protect media containing information against unauthorized access, misuse or corruption during transportation
subgoals.embedding_context: Protect media containing information against unauthorized access, misuse or corruption during transportation

actions.name: Remote File Access Mediation
actions.description: Remote file access mediation is the process of managing and securing access to file systems over a network to ensure that only authorized users or processes can interact with remote files.

actions.name: File Encryption
actions.description: Encrypting a file using a cryptographic key.

actions.name: IO Port Restriction
actions.description: Limiting access to computer input/output (IO) ports to restrict unauthorized devices.

actions.name: Disk Encryption
actions.description: Encrypting a hard disk partition to prevent cleartext access to a file system.

actions.name: Content Quarantine
actions.description: Transfer content that does not comply with policy to a quarantine zone.

actions.name: Utilize integrity controls in hardware
actions.description: Utilize tamper-evident packaging, secure shipping protocols, and block chain-based tracking systems to ensure the integrity of hardware and software during distribution, preventing unauthorized access or modifications.
